name: honmoon-redact
description: Client-side secret/PII redaction hooks: keep API keys and sensitive identifiers out of Claude Code's model context by redacting Read/Bash/Grep tool output, blocking prompts that carry secrets, and denying reads of known credential files. Session-transcript scrubbing verified on Claude Code 2.1.263 (updatedToolOutput is what gets persisted); re-verify on other versions.

transport.title: Engine transport
transport.description: How the hooks module reaches the redaction engine: "process" (default, runs `honmoon hook`) or "http" (POSTs to hookUrl).

honmoonBin.title: honmoon binary
honmoonBin.description: The honmoon binary the process transport runs (command name or absolute path).

hookUrl.title: Management API hook URL
hookUrl.description: Management-API endpoint for the http transport, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7777/api/hooks/claude-code.

failMode.title: Failure mode
failMode.description: What the hooks module does when the engine is unreachable: "closed" (default, deny the tool output / drop the prompt) or "open" (pass through, like the command hooks).
